reviewed_by: Codex review of desktop release deployment status recording
reason: The daily release driver currently records unsuccessful candidate attempts as desktop-release deployments, while successful release and updater jobs suppress deployment records. The change keeps preparation gated without creating a deployment and records a successful deployment only after the published release and updater Pages deployment succeed. The selected tests verify the gate, the existing no-deployment policy for preparation jobs, and the exact-tag publication record.
exclusions: No Nebula product UI, browser journey, frontend unit, native code, or packaged binary changes. Playwright, frontend, native, unrelated Python tests, and full suites are excluded. Local collection and focused execution use Python 3.11.7; CI uses selected Python 3.12.
